parameters.name: num_activities
parameters.description: The number of activities in the project network

parameters.name: num_precedence_arcs
parameters.description: The number of immediate precedence arcs

parameters.name: precedence_arcs
parameters.description: The precedence arc list where each arc stores predecessor and successor activity indices

parameters.name: work_cost_per_day
parameters.description: Uniform work cost rate per day over the project timeline

parameters.name: machine_rental_cost_per_day
parameters.description: Machine rental cost rate per day over the rental interval

parameters.name: machine_start_activity
parameters.description: Index of the anchor activity whose start time defines the beginning of the machine rental interval

parameters.name: machine_end_activity
parameters.description: Index of the anchor activity whose finish time defines the end of the machine rental interval

constraints.name: precedence_feasibility
constraints.description: Each immediate precedence relation must be respected so a predecessor finishes before its successor starts.

constraints.name: activity_timing_definitions
constraints.description: Start and finish times are linked by fixed durations, with nonnegative start times and an upper bound by the planning horizon.
constraints.formula: f_i = s_i + d_i,\quad 0 \le s_i \le T,\quad 0 \le f_i \le T\qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}

constraints.name: project_completion_time_definition
constraints.description: The project completion time equals the latest activity finish time and is bounded by the planning horizon.

constraints.name: machine_rental_duration_definition
constraints.description: The machine rental duration is the nonnegative difference between the designated end-anchor finish time and start-anchor start time.

constraints.name: total_cost_definition
constraints.description: The total cost equals work-time cost over the project completion time plus machine rental cost over the rental duration.

objectives.name: total_project_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total project cost composed of work-time cost and machine rental cost

final_objective.description: Minimize the total project cost, defined as the sum of uniform work-time cost over the project completion time and machine rental cost over the rental duration.
